description: This file defines a utility function `aggregateAgentsUsageAndCost` that aggregates agent costs and usage data across two MongoDB collections ('session_tracking' and 'llm-costs'). It handles parsing currency strings, merging data from different collection structures, and supports filtering options. The function returns a structured summary including total costs, usage, session counts per agent, and source breakdowns.
